newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden confirms cabinet moves, names industry min.
newsitem.headline: Sweden confirms cabinet moves, names industry min.

text.p: A Swedish government press secretary on Tuesday confirmed that junior cabinet minister with the prime minsiter's office, Leif Pagrotsky, was to be appointed Industry and Commerce Minister.
The move was the first confirmation of any cabinet changes following rumours earlier that a reshuffle was imminent.
"There is some truth in the rumours (about a cabinet reshuffle)," Leif-Ake Falk, Pagrotsky's press secretary, told Reuters.
"As (Bjorn) Von Sydow will move on to other tasks, Pagrotsky will become Industry and Commerce Minister," he said.
This will be Pagrotsky's first position with a government portfolio.
Von Sydow currently holds that post but will become Sweden's new defence minister, replacing Thage Peterson, according to political newspaper Dagens Politik's internet home page.
Peterson, a leading member of the Social Democrats and heavyweight in parliament, was likely to be given a position in the inner cabinet, replacing Pagrotsky, Ddagens Politik said.
The other moves are yet to be confirmed.
The minority Social Democratic government was to hold a cabinet meeting sometime on Tuesday and Prime Minister Goran Persson was likely to announce the changes after that, Falk said.
Persson has made no major changes to cabinet since he took over the leadership of the ruling Social Democrats Party and became prime minister in March 1996.
